fields.label: Each shortcut adds a menu that opens its URL. Leave Entity empty for a menu under Plugins in the application menu, or name an entity (projects, contacts, companies, project_team, project_locations, project_notes, meeting_attendees, item_tracker, item_tracker_updates, status_report_items) to add it to that record's right-click menu. A URL can use {{ entity.column }} for a value of the clicked record, such as {{ projects.project_number }}, and {{ preferences.managingCompanyName }}, {{ preferences.managerName }} and {{ preferences.managerId }}.
